Bill.BriefDescription: Shortening the statute of limitations on claims under chapter 42.17 RCW.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to limitation on actions; and amending RCW42.17.410.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.17.410 and 1982 c 147 s 18 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any action brought under the provisions of this chapter must becommenced within ((five)) two years after the date when the violationoccurred.
